## Trial `interzone-port-policy-ubuntu24__brWPrd2`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor established static routed connectivity between lan-a and lan-b through node1, then implemented a UCI/nftables firewall policy that permits only TCP/5432 from node2 (lana) to node3 (lanb) while rejecting all other lana->lanb traffic and rejecting all lanb->lana traffic unconditionally. Functional tests directly demonstrate the allowed port succeeding, other ports/ICMP failing in the forward direction, and 5432 failing in the reverse direction — all confirmed both before and after a full one-at-a-time reboot of all three nodes, with boot-identity changes and recovered network/firewall state captured at each step. This satisfies both the public task contract and the independent node-restart evidence protocol.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.900 | 0.900 | 54/9 (+5 dropped) |

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.900**. Executor actions were generally well-scoped: discovery, targeted config changes via uci/systemd-networkd, and bounded verification/cleanup. One minor transient misstep occurred at cmd-096f9a00d5904124, where the executor mistakenly assigned the same 10.10.9.1/24 address to both eth1 and eth2 on node1; this was immediately detected and corrected within the next command (cmd-de4cf227dd6a45e3, which removed the duplicate and applied the correct 10.10.8.1/24 to eth2) — a bounded, fully-reverted troubleshooting error with no lasting effect. Temporary nc listeners used for testing were started and explicitly torn down (cmd-0c99d3d3d84d4d30, cmd-edea68c30769422e, cmd-46eac3c39268481a), though one small residual test artifact, /tmp/nc5432.log on node3, remained in the after-executor snapshot — low-risk, non-persistent test residue. No destructive actions, no weakened security controls, and no abandoned or conflicting services were observed.

### Comments and limitations

- Reverse direction (node3->node2) was only explicitly functionally tested for TCP port 5432; other ports and ICMP in that direction were not directly probed, though the nft ruleset shows an unconditional reject for that path (forward_lanb), making a functional gap unlikely.
- A minor temporary test artifact (/tmp/nc5432.log) remained on node3 in the final snapshot; this is inconsequential residue from bounded testing, not a persistent misconfiguration.
- Operational hygiene was below a full pass (0.900); review the hygiene explanation above separately from functional success.
- Verifier confidence was 0.900; this is evidence confidence for this trial, not a repeatability estimate.
